The main takeaway from our work is that
the flow-alignment transition for increasing reactive parameter lambda is a re-entrant viscoelastic (G' and delta) transition: visco-elastic -->viscous-->viscoelastic.
the flow-alignment transition is a reentrant transition in linear viscoelastic properties of liquid crystals, which can be easily detected by measuring the storage modulus and the loss angle.
the alignment-nonaligment transition for increasing lambda can be assessed by measuring the linear viscoelastic modulus G' of a nematic liquid crystal.
